tagline: Leading European alternative asset manager with €49bn AuM and record fundraising momentum
hero_kpi_rationale: Tikehau Capital strengthened its position in the European AI and high-performance computing sector by increasing its investment to €160M in Eclairion, a HPC and AI specialist, positioning the group as a key player in financing European technological innovation.

kpis.name: Investment in HPC and AI
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in Eclairion, European specialist in high-performance computing and AI.
kpis.description: Tikehau Capital increased its initial investment from €110M to €160M in Eclairion to accelerate growth, marking a strong commitment to HPC and AI.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in a pioneering European AI company.

kpis.name: Net new money
kpis.explanation: Net cash inflows from investors into the company's funds.
kpis.description: Net inflows reached €7.0 billion in 2024, of which €2.3 billion in Q4, up 28% versus Q4 2023.

kpis.name: Assets under management (asset management)
kpis.explanation: Total assets managed by the company in its asset management activities.
kpis.description: AuM reached €49.0 billion at end-2024, growing 15% year-over-year and 24% CAGR since 2016.

kpis.name: Fee-paying assets under management
kpis.explanation: Assets on which the company generates management fees.
kpis.description: Fee-paying AuM reached €39.8 billion at end-2024, up 14% year-over-year.

kpis.name: Recurring management earnings
kpis.explanation: Earnings from management activities, excluding non-recurring items and share-based payment charges.
kpis.description: Core FRE reached €132.0 million in 2024, up 7% year-over-year, driven by strong acceleration in H2.
kpis.signal: Growth in recurring earnings, with sharp acceleration in H2 (+37%).

kpis.name: Management fees
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from management fees on assets under management.
kpis.description: Management fees reached €337.1 million in 2024, up 8% versus 2023.

kpis.name: Capital deployment
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in closed-end funds during the year.
kpis.description: Capital deployment reached €5.6 billion in 2024, down 4% year-over-year, despite positive momentum in H2.
kpis.signal: Modest decline in 2024, but acceleration in H2.

kpis.name: Shareholders' equity
kpis.explanation: Shareholders' equity held by the group's shareholders.
kpis.description: Shareholders' equity reached €3.245 billion at end-2024, up 2% year-over-year.

kpis.name: Increased investment in HPC and AI specialists
kpis.explanation: Increase in investment to €160M in Eclairion, European company specializing in high-performance computing and AI hosting services.
kpis.description: The increased investment to €160M in Eclairion reflects an active strategy to finance cutting-edge European technology in high-performance computing and AI services.
kpis.signal: Active positioning as an AI innovation integrator in Europe.

kpis.name: Assets dedicated to climate and biodiversity
kpis.explanation: Assets specifically allocated to sustainable strategies focused on climate and biodiversity.
kpis.description: Assets dedicated to climate and biodiversity increased 37% in 2024 to reach €4.1 billion.

ai_positioning.summary: Tikehau Capital positions itself as an active integrator of AI innovation in Europe, financing pioneering companies like Eclairion in high-performance computing and AI hosting services.
